correctness.rationale: Zhong's support theorem applies to this order-ideal polytope and counts disjoint matchable endpoint pairs, not the bijections witnessing them. Disjointness rules out equality, so the minimal and maximal shores of the crown's strict-comparability graph supply all the sources and targets. This graph is the simple cycle C_{2m} also at m=3. A proper set of endpoints induces a forest, and the symmetric difference of distinct perfect matchings would contain a cycle. Thus below j=m there is exactly one witness per matchable pair. At j=m the single endpoint pair has two witnesses, giving the subtraction of q^m. Marking one selected edge counts j-matchings as (2m/j) binom(2m−j−1,j−1), and the closed-walk trace of the two-state edge-selection matrix counts cyclic matchings. Its eigenvalues satisfy λ²−λ−q=0; their squares have sum 1+2q and product q², giving the Chebyshev expression first for q>0 and then as a polynomial identity. On each angular interval (jπ/m,(j+1)π/m), cos(mθ)=1/2 holds once at the stated angle, with nonzero derivative. The corresponding q=1/[2(cosθ−1)] is strictly below −1/4, and these m distinct values exhaust the degree. For every q<0 the t-equation has discriminant 1−4q>0, product 1 and negative sum 1/q−2. Roots from different q cannot overlap, and H_m(−1)=(−1)^m≠0. The reciprocal negative pairs exhaust the degree 2m. At m=3 the correction changes 1+6q+9q²+2q³ to 1+6q+9q²+q³, giving the stated support coefficients.

Athanasiadis–Chapoton pose general support real-rootedness, not an all-order root theorem for crowns. Zhong provides a counterexample in a separate family. Cao–Fu prove simple negative roots for a crown order-polytope Ehrhart numerator, of degree 2m−2, not the degree-2m preorder support polynomial.

The closest positive general matching-root theorem omits the cycle needed here. The two crown polynomials with real roots have different degrees, constructions and coefficient meanings.

value.rationale: The crown is a natural cyclic family at the first obstruction to uniqueness of matching witnesses. Resolving that top-degree obstruction gives what general positivity does not: an exact all-order real-rooted family with explicit simple reciprocal roots, in a setting where general real-rootedness fails. This is useful for distinguishing which structures preserve strict real-rootedness and is more than rechecking a small crown or invoking ordinary matching roots.
residual_risks: The result does not settle any other class of preorders or give a flag-sphere realization for the crown.
